panels.description: Current sensor values from main cluster

matcher.options: /^Dry Bulb$|^Wet Bulb$|^RH$|^VPD$|^Pressure$|^Secondary Temp$|^Secondary RH$|^Water Level$|^Last Update$/

targets.rawSql: WITH sensor_data AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.sensor_id) CASE s.name WHEN 'dry_bulb_v' THEN 'Dry Bulb' WHEN 'wet_bulb_v' THEN 'Wet Bulb' WHEN 'rh_v' THEN 'RH' WHEN 'vpd_v' THEN 'VPD' WHEN 'co2_v' THEN 'CO2' WHEN 'pressure_v' THEN 'Pressure' WHEN 'secondary_temp_v' THEN 'Secondary Temp' WHEN 'secondary_rh_v' THEN 'Secondary RH' WHEN 'water_level_v' THEN 'Water Level' ELSE s.name END AS sensor_name, m.value AS value_num, CASE WHEN s.name LIKE 'dry_bulb%' OR s.name LIKE 'secondary_temp%' THEN '°C' WHEN s.name LIKE 'wet_bulb%' THEN '°C' WHEN s.name LIKE 'rh%' AND s.name NOT LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN '%' WHEN s.name LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN '%' WHEN s.name LIKE 'vpd%' THEN ' kPa' WHEN s.name LIKE 'co2%' THEN ' ppm' WHEN s.name LIKE 'pressure%' THEN ' hPa' WHEN s.name LIKE 'water_level%' THEN ' mm' ELSE '' END AS unit, m.time AS time_val, CASE WHEN s.name LIKE 'dry_bulb%' THEN 1 WHEN s.name LIKE 'wet_bulb%' THEN 2 WHEN s.name LIKE 'rh%' AND s.name NOT LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN 3 WHEN s.name LIKE 'vpd%' THEN 4 WHEN s.name LIKE 'co2%' THEN 5 WHEN s.name LIKE 'pressure%' THEN 6 WHEN s.name LIKE 'secondary_temp%' THEN 7 WHEN s.name LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN 8 WHEN s.name LIKE 'water_level%' THEN 9 ELSE 10 END AS sort_order FROM measurement m JOIN sensor s ON m.sensor_id = s.sensor_id WHERE s.name LIKE '%_v' AND m.time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '10 minutes' ORDER BY s.sensor_id, m.time DESC), combined AS (SELECT sensor_name AS "Data", sort_order, 1 AS row_type FROM sensor_data UNION ALL SELECT (value_num::text || unit) AS "Data", sort_order, 2 AS row_type FROM sensor_data UNION ALL SELECT 'Last Update' AS "Data", 999 AS sort_order, 1 AS row_type FROM sensor_data UNION ALL SELECT TO_CHAR(MAX(time_val), 'YYYY/MM/DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "Data", 999 AS sort_order, 2 AS row_type FROM sensor_data) SELECT "Data" FROM combined ORDER BY sort_order, row_type

panels.title: Sensor Values

targets.rawSql: SELECT time AS "time", sensor_name AS metric, value FROM measurement_with_metadata WHERE sensor_name IN ('dry_bulb_v', 'wet_bulb_v', 'rh_v', 'vpd_v') AND time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() ORDER BY time, sensor_name

WITH filtered_setpoints AS (
  SELECT 
    es.timestamp,
    es.effective_heating_setpoint
  FROM effective_setpoints es
  WHERE es.location = 'Veg Room' 
    AND es.cluster = 'main' 
    AND es.effective_heating_setpoint IS NOT NULL
    AND es.timestamp >= $__timeFrom()
    AND es.timestamp <= $__timeTo()
    AND (
      (es.mode = 'DAY' AND EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM schedules s
        WHERE s.location = 'Veg Room'
          AND s.cluster = 'main'
          AND s.mode = 'DAY'
          AND s.enabled = true
          AND (s.day_of_week IS NULL OR s.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM es.timestamp))
          AND (
            (s.start_time <= s.end_time AND es.timestamp::time >= s.start_time AND es.timestamp::time < s.end_time)
            OR (s.start_time > s.end_time AND (es.timestamp::time >= s.start_time OR es.timestamp::time < s.end_time))
          )
      ))
      OR
      (es.mode = 'NIGHT' AND NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM schedules s
        WHERE s.location = 'Veg Room'
          AND s.cluster = 'main'
          AND s.mode = 'DAY'
          AND s.enabled = true
          AND (s.day_of_week IS NULL OR s.day_of_week = EXTRACT(DOW FROM es.timestamp))
          AND (
            (s.start_time <= s.end_time AND es.timestamp::time >= s.start_time AND es.timestamp::time < s.end_time)
            OR (s.start_time > s.end_time AND (es.timestamp::time >= s.start_time OR es.timestamp::time < s.end_time))
          )
      ))
    )
),
last_setpoint AS (
  SELECT effective_heating_setpoint, timestamp
  FROM filtered_setpoints
  ORDER BY timestamp DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT timestamp AS "time", 'Heating Setpoint - Main' AS metric, effective_heating_setpoint AS value
FROM filtered_setpoints
UNION ALL
SELECT $__timeTo() AS "time", 'Heating Setpoint - Main' AS metric, effective_heating_setpoint AS value
FROM last_setpoint
WHERE effective_heating_setpoint IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "time"

WITH time_points AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('minute', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz),
    $__timeTo()::timestamptz + INTERVAL '1 minute',
    INTERVAL '1 minute'
  ) AS utc_time
),
local_points AS (
  SELECT
    utc_time,
    timezone('America/Toronto', utc_time) AS local_time
  FROM time_points
),
room_schedule AS (
  SELECT start_time AS day_start_time, end_time AS day_end_time
  FROM schedules
  WHERE location = 'Veg Room' 
    AND cluster = 'main'
    AND device_name = 'room_schedule'
    AND enabled = true
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  lp.utc_time AS "time",
  'DAY Period Overlay' AS metric,
  CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM room_schedule)
      AND (
        SELECT CASE 
          WHEN (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) <= (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
            THEN lp.local_time::time >= (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) 
                 AND lp.local_time::time < (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
          ELSE lp.local_time::time >= (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) 
               OR lp.local_time::time < (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
        END
      )
    THEN 100.0
    ELSE NULL
  END AS value
FROM local_points lp

WITH time_points AS (

    date_trunc('minute', $__timeFrom()::timestamptz),

local_points AS (

    timezone('America/Toronto', utc_time) AS local_time
  FROM time_points
),
room_schedule AS (
  SELECT start_time AS day_start_time, end_time AS day_end_time
  FROM schedules
  WHERE location = 'Veg Room' 
    AND cluster = 'main'
    AND device_name = 'room_schedule'
    AND enabled = true

  LIMIT 1

SELECT 
  lp.utc_time AS "time",
  'NIGHT Period Overlay' AS metric,
  CASE 
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM room_schedule)
      AND NOT (
        SELECT CASE 
          WHEN (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) <= (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
            THEN lp.local_time::time >= (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) 
                 AND lp.local_time::time < (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
          ELSE lp.local_time::time >= (SELECT day_start_time FROM room_schedule) 
               OR lp.local_time::time < (SELECT day_end_time FROM room_schedule)
        END
      )
    THEN 100.0
    ELSE NULL
  END AS value
FROM local_points lp

SELECT CASE sensor_name WHEN 'dry_bulb_v' THEN 'Dry Bulb (°C)' WHEN 'wet_bulb_v' THEN 'Wet Bulb (°C)' WHEN 'rh_v' THEN 'RH (%)' WHEN 'vpd_v' THEN 'VPD (kPa)' WHEN 'co2_v' THEN 'CO2 (ppm)' WHEN 'pressure_v' THEN 'Pressure (hPa)' WHEN 'secondary_temp_v' THEN 'Secondary Temp (°C)' WHEN 'secondary_rh_v' THEN 'Secondary RH (%)' WHEN 'water_level_v' THEN 'Water Level (mm)' ELSE sensor_name END AS "Sensor", MIN(value) AS "Min", MAX(value) AS "Max", AVG(value) AS "Average", COALESCE(STDDEV(value), 0) AS "Std Dev" FROM measurement_with_metadata WHERE time >= $__timeFrom() AND time <= $__timeTo() AND sensor_name LIKE '%_v' GROUP BY sensor_name ORDER BY CASE WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'dry_bulb%' THEN 1 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'wet_bulb%' THEN 2 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'rh%' AND sensor_name NOT LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN 3 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'vpd%' THEN 4 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'co2%' THEN 5 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'pressure%' THEN 6 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'secondary_temp%' THEN 7 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'secondary_rh%' THEN 8 WHEN sensor_name LIKE 'water_level%' THEN 9 ELSE 10 END, sensor_name
